findings.description: With Zephyr, Method M achieved higher unseen-domain accuracy than both ZeroGen and SuperGen on SGD and Clinc150.
With Llama3, Method M achieved higher unseen-domain accuracy than both ZeroGen and SuperGen on SGD and Clinc150, attaining the highest T1 mean on each dataset.
Method M using either open 7–8B generator outperformed ZeroGen using ChatGPT on both SGD and Clinc150.

At the default 1x data volume, fine-tuning the rewriter improved Method M accuracy over the non-fine-tuned rewriter in all four dataset–generator settings, by 2.7–7.2 percentage points, and every improvement was significant in a one-sided paired t-test at alpha 0.05.

The baseline comparisons in T1 are descriptive because no significance test was reported, while the ablation reports only significance markers and omits exact p-values, test statistics, and the pairing unit.

numeric_facts.description: Method M with Llama3 achieved 72.4% accuracy on SGD, the highest SGD mean in T1.
Method M with Llama3 achieved 76.9% accuracy on Clinc150, the highest Clinc150 mean in T1.
On SGD, Method M with Llama3 exceeded the strongest non-Method-M result, ZeroGen with Llama3, by 3.7 percentage points.
On Clinc150, Method M with Llama3 exceeded the strongest non-Method-M result, ZeroGen with Llama3, by 3.1 percentage points.
At 1x on SGD with Zephyr, fine-tuning the rewriter improved accuracy by 7.2 percentage points.
At 1x on SGD with Llama3, fine-tuning the rewriter improved accuracy by 4.9 percentage points.
At 1x on Clinc150 with Zephyr, fine-tuning the rewriter improved accuracy by 2.7 percentage points.
At 1x on Clinc150 with Llama3, fine-tuning the rewriter improved accuracy by 3.1 percentage points.
